title: Full Progress: CI Runners Shared Pool
hero: Manager for shared self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on your own machines: controller, node agent, web console, CLI and tray in one binary, crsp.
lede: v0.1.2 is installed on the owner's PC; v0.1.3 (RELEASE-22 to RELEASE-25: first-run rework, TUI panes, guided GitHub grant, parity access) is building. A tag and a build ship no code of their own, so they show under Other work, not as a release. Task IDs are tracker IDs.
